verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agent-management platform, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk capability. It covers per-agent management via the dashboard, API, CLI and hosted MCP, plus conversation search, none of which is a documented multi-item bulk action. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
